body: The same happens if I use `File` instead of `String` as the body. To reproduce, use the branch [`file`](https://github.com/jdussouillez/quarkus-reader-interceptor-req-size/blob/file/src/main/java/org/acme/rest/client/TestResource.java#L18) on my repo.

When using a multipart body there is no error. But it's because the `ReaderInterceptor` is not called. I don't know if this is expected or not.

To test it, use the branch [`multipart-body`](https://github.com/jdussouillez/quarkus-reader-interceptor-req-size/tree/multipart-body)

/cc @Sirz3chs
This is similar but not exactly the same as #31606
